teaser: A page that builds a first version of a sovereign website in your browser, showing every agent, behaviour policy and penny, then hands back a zip.
core_idea: Like the Web Summit X-ray and voice-note demos, a static page can run a team of agents in the visitor's browser with their own key, build a first version of their website, show each agent's behaviour policy being enforced and the cost climbing, return a zip, and run the same brief on several models as visible evals.

quotes.text: A browser tab can run a team of agents, show them working, and hand back something real.
The important part is that the policies are visible while they work.
